system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Medicine

You aim your strike to cripple your opponent.

If you roll a 6 on an attack against a creature and your attack deals damage, you can spend 1 Resolve to strike them in a vulnerable spot.

If you do so, they reduce their Speed by -1 until the next time they take a Long Rest.

Additionally, any time the affected creature chooses to Move during combat, it suffers 1 Damage.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.lTfvfy8eH6XZIATw]{Sever Tendons}
